hypotheses.statement: STEP transfers using distinct STEPControl_Writer instances and explicit DESTEP_Parameters retain their own unit/schema/precision configuration under concurrent threads.
hypotheses.falsified_by: A threaded job emits another job's schema/unit markers, readback geometry is corrupted, or threaded transfer fails while the same sequential baseline succeeds reproducibly.

hypotheses.statement: BRepAlgoAPI Boolean work with SetRunParallel set explicitly per instance can execute independently of BOPAlgo_Options global parallel mode.
hypotheses.falsified_by: Per-instance jobs produce wrong geometry/nondeterminism correlated with another thread's local flag, or require the process-global flag for correctness.

hypotheses.statement: BOPAlgo_Options::SetParallelMode is process-global and therefore unsuitable for per-job conflicting policy in one process.
hypotheses.falsified_by: Independent threads can repeatedly set conflicting values without observing another thread's value.

hypotheses.statement: Read-only shared TopoDS_TShape ownership through copied TopoDS_Shape handles is compatible with the intended immutable-input ownership pattern, distinct from concurrent mutation safety.
hypotheses.falsified_by: The shared input changes volume or triggers failures when multiple non-destructive readers/Boolean jobs use it concurrently.

hypotheses.statement: Worker-process isolation contains process-global state and failures with acceptable overhead for the founding OpenSimachinist architecture.
hypotheses.falsified_by: Process-isolated jobs show the same cross-talk attributable to process-global state or overhead is disproportionate to geometry/STEP work.

negative_result_policy: Research failures and cross-talk are preserved as evidence; CI fails only when the pinned baseline or campaign itself cannot execute and produce evidence.
boundaries: No claim of global OCCT thread safety or unsafety beyond measured APIs and topology.
No concurrent mutation of shared TopoDS_TShape state is claimed safe.
RCS-005 STEP conformance remains the correctness contract; file creation alone is not success.
